source.description: format of the source image next to these settings (same name)

compress.description: none: use the source image; uastc: KTX2, high quality; etc1s: KTX2, smallest file

maxSize.description: when compressing, scale down so the longer side is at most this many pixels; 0: no limit

srgb.description: color image (stored as sRGB); turn off for normal, roughness and other data maps

alpha.description: when compressing, replace the alpha with the brightness of this image (a height map packed into a normal map for parallax); content path of a image asset (no extension)
